name: poly-fanout
description: Layer: fan the saved chord out on playback. Hooked at 0x08021A6E (inside the melodic player 0x8021A14, r0=step, r4=voice_obj, r8=pattern parent). Reproduces the original strb, then reads poly[track][step] from CCM 0x1000B530 (track=channel-1; stride track*0x880 + step*17; byte0=count, then [note,vel] pairs) and emits every note EXCEPT the primary (sl) through the self-contained note pair 0x8019A92 (note-on + note-off, so no stuck notes). Stack args mirror the player's own call site 0x80217F4: [sp]=note,[sp+4]=vel,[sp+8]=channel; r3=[obj+4]. v1 assumes default melodic channels 1..3 (track=channel-1).
